en.title: Kármán Vortex Street
en.teaser: Fluid flowing past a cylinder sheds alternating swirling eddies, creating periodic wake patterns and violent vibrations.

en.hook: Why do tall smokestacks and submarine periscopes have spiral fins wrapped around their outer hulls?
en.math: Kármán vortex shedding creates periodic pressure imbalances, driving violent cross-flow vibrations at Strouhal frequency.
en.question: Can we simulate Kármán vortex streets, boundary layer detachment, and oscillating lift live in Kotlin Multiplatform?
en.code_tip: We calculate Reynolds regimes, render alternating counter-rotating vortex cores, and animate streaklines on Canvas.
en.payoff: The Kármán vortex street running live in Kotlin.
